data.title: 一色彩羽 · 走廊小跑追赶的娇嗔鼓腮·「八幡前辈！走太快了啦，等等我！」
data.description: 【总武高夕阳走廊·放学后】抱着一沓学生会文件的彩羽一路小跑追赶。文件挡在胸前，两只脚丫在地板上踏出清脆声响。追上你之后她微微喘息，有些生气地鼓起腮帮子仰视，蜜茶色双马尾随步伐跳动，可爱得令人心动。
data.location: 总武高中教学楼黄昏走廊
data.action: 小跑追赶手抱文件喘息，鼓腮娇嗔仰视，百褶裙轻扬
data.lighting: 走廊一整排落地窗透入的橘红色斜阳
data.camera: medium shot, holding documents, running, pouting, hallway sunset
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki hurries down the wooden school corridor clutching council printouts against her open navy blazer, stopping with puffed cheeks and a playfully annoyed upward glance. Cream cardigan, red ribbon and plaid skirt remain beneath bouncing low wavy twintails. The medium view follows the tall window row into the distance. Orange-red sunset illuminates her collar and paper edges, casting long window-frame shadows across the polished floor behind her.
